task: A request mentioning a multi-dot source filename is treated as having no path signal. Locate the extraction rule for file references in user text.
Repeated delivery of the same request rebuilds prepared context for one session. Locate the cache decision that should reuse the previous packet.
The benchmark's saved prepared context differs from what was inserted into the model prompt. Locate the function responsible for writing that capture.
Task events are recorded but disappear from the local event stream after a run. Locate the append operation that persists each event.
A risky permission request is not flagged even though its title contains a configured warning word. Locate the keyword decision.
A chained test and build command is classified under the wrong tool-output family. Locate the compound-command classifier.
A leading slash command in the user's request fails to force the intended routing choice. Locate override parsing.
An environment setting that disables output filtering loses to the plugin's enabled option. Locate the configuration precedence rule.
Searching a recovered raw command log returns the wrong surrounding lines. Locate the search-mode line selection in the recovery tool.
A diagnostic canary runs when its environment switch is disabled. Locate the boolean gate for that switch.
